Voice Input Stream Denial of Service [Denial of Service, CWE-400] on API Gateway, Lambda Functions, Kinesis Data Streams: The attacker exploits the lack of proper input validation and rate limiting by sending large voice files or streaming data that exceeds system processing capabilities. An attacker writes a script to continuously send large voice files through the API endpoint, consuming Lambda execution time and Kinesis throughput capacity.

Lambda Function Compromise [Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-269] on Lambda Functions, S3 Buckets, DynamoDB Table, KMS Key, AI/ML Services: Attackers could exploit vulnerabilities in Lambda function code or dependencies to gain execution control and access AWS resources using the function's IAM role. An attacker exploits a vulnerability in a dependency used by the Lambda function to execute arbitrary code and access sensitive data in S3 or DynamoDB.

Cognito Authentication Bypass [Spoofing, Information Disclosure, CWE-307] on Cognito User Pool, API Gateway, Lambda Functions: Attackers attempt to gain unauthorized access by exploiting weak passwords, brute-forcing credentials, or bypassing authentication mechanisms. An attacker uses automated tools to attempt login with commonly used passwords or exploits password reset functionality.

Cross-Account Resource Access [Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-284] on Transcribe, Lex, Polly, IAM Roles, Lambda Functions: Misconfigured service-linked roles (SLRs) or IAM policies could allow unauthorized cross-account access to AI/ML services and data. An attacker exploits overly permissive cross-account access to exfiltrate voice data or manipulate AI service configurations.

Kinesis Stream Manipulation [Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-345] on Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda Functions, IAM Roles: Attackers could exploit misconfigured IAM permissions or service endpoints to manipulate Kinesis stream configurations or data. An attacker with elevated privileges modifies Kinesis stream settings to redirect data to an unauthorized destination.
